description: ScrollingIconGrid fills top 45%, OverlayKeyword sits on top, avatar split-screen below. Brand logo bounces in top-right corner.
notes: Use this for any editorial-authority hook where brand names appear in the first 3 seconds. Brands shown in ScrollingIconGrid cards. OverlayKeyword shows the value hook line.

broll.notes: ScrollingIconGrid renders automatically when asset field is 'scroll-grid-hook' — GenericReelComposition handles this

adaptation_notes: Replace 'HOOK TEXT HERE' with the actual hook line from the script
Replace brands/ProductName.svg with the actual brand SVG path
Adjust start/end times to match actual beat timing from beat-map.json
If multiple brands appear in hook, add one LogoOverlay per brand with staggered start times (0.0, 0.4, 0.8)
